$comment: The repos the map measures. Each node in graph.ts claims one repo (and optionally a path prefix within it) via its `measure` key. Geometry is derived from these counts; prose is authored.
$ignoreNote: Tests, vendored lint rules and generated bundles are excluded so the skyline reflects the code that runs. site-studio's template-content.ts is 17k generated lines of inlined template HTML — counting it would make one building four times taller than anything else for no reason a reader could see.
